description: Search for rental vehicles at an airport or city. Lists every available car with vendor, class, rate details, and the identifiers get_vehicle_details needs, in Gondola's recommended order unless sort is "price". A very large result ends with a count of cars not shown; narrow it with vendor, vehicle_class, or sort.

dropoff_datetime.description: Drop-off date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-20T10:00:00").

dropoff_query.description: Optional free-text drop-off location for a one-way rental, using the same formats as pickup_query. Omit for a round trip returning to the pickup location.

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-15T10:00:00").

pickup_query.description: Optional free-text pickup location: airport IATA, metro IATA, city, address, point of interest, or "lat,lon". When present, this takes precedence over pickup_location and includes both airport and city-desk inventory. Keep pickup_location populated as a compatible airport, metro, or city value.

sort.description: Optional result order. "recommended" (default) is Gondola's blend of price, distance, discount codes, and loyalty. "price" orders by total price, lowest first.

vehicle_class.description: Optional vehicle class: Economy, Compact, Standard, FullSize, Premium, Luxury, SUV, Van.

vendor.description: Optional rental company to keep, by name or vendor code (e.g. "Hertz", "ZE", "Alamo"). Case-insensitive; matches a vendor code exactly or the start of a company name, so "Fox" finds "Fox Rent A Car". Omit to list every company.

name: search_vehicles
